## Problem Statement

Binance Spot Live is available as an ordinary-account connection, but read-only authentication and existing order observations do not deliver the complete trusted execution path. Production crypto quote/venue/rule evidence, account restrictions, Live PLACE dispatch, private-stream recovery and separately authorized real-provider acceptance remain incomplete. The user explicitly selected S29 before the blocked S28 acceptance; that changes scheduling only.

## Solution

Deliver Binance Spot Live through the existing trusted TradeX Control Plane and isolated Order Execution Gateway. Show each account's actual permissions, trading restrictions and evidence gaps. Require current, exact instrument/rule/quote/venue/time and genuinely needed FX evidence, explicit Arm and an immutable single-use financial approval before a bounded Spot order. Preserve provider truth, fills, fees, capacity and query-first recovery. Keep local contract/fault evidence distinct from real-provider financial acceptance.

## User Stories

1. As a user, I want to reuse my saved Binance Live connection, so that I do not re-enter keys for a read-only refresh.
2. As a user, I want Live and historical Testnet identities kept separate, so that no operation is routed to the wrong environment.
3. As a user, I want complete current API-key scope and IP restrictions shown, so that successful reads are not mistaken for trading permission.
4. As a user, I want withdrawal, transfer and unsupported derivative permissions to block execution, so that the application retains its Spot boundary.
5. As a user, I want Binance system maintenance and exact-account trading locks shown, so that I understand account-specific execution blockers.
6. As a user, I want missing, malformed or failed status reads shown as incomplete, so that they are never interpreted as normal operation.
7. As a user, I want status changes to invalidate prior execution readiness and consent, so that old authority cannot survive a degraded account.
8. As a user, I want exact BTC/USDT and ETH/USDT trading rules and permission-set constraints, so that unsupported or halted instruments are not offered as tradable.
9. As a user, I want authentic bid/ask, quantities, depth sequencing and provider timestamps, so that a last-trade price or receipt time is not substituted for executable liquidity evidence.
10. As a user, I want stale, crossed, discontinuous or disconnected market evidence blocked, so that trade checks fail closed.
11. As a user, I want venue/source/connection generations bound to evidence, so that switching sources retires earlier quotes and approvals.
12. As a user, I want data rights and regional access limitations stated, so that public access is not treated as licence or jurisdiction approval.
13. As a user, I want Binance time/signature checks performed against the fixed ordinary endpoint, so that routing or clock errors do not bypass safety.
14. As a user, I want original BASE/QUOTE and fee currencies retained, so that USDT is never assumed to equal USD.
15. As a user, I want FX checked only for actual required conversions with execution quality and cost, so that irrelevant conversions are not invented and required ones are not skipped.
16. As a user, I want explicit account Arm separate from financial approval, so that selecting Live does not authorize an order.
17. As a user, I want an immutable Proposal with maximum authorized spend, fees and risk decisions, so that approval authorizes exactly the reviewed intent.
18. As a user, I want Prepare to atomically consume approval and reserve capacity, so that concurrent orders cannot overspend.
19. As a user, I want dispatch through the authenticated child Gateway after durable SUBMITTING, so that generic model/tool access cannot place orders.
20. As a user, I want exactly one provider mutation for each consumed grant, so that retries cannot duplicate orders.
21. As a user, I want uncertain submissions queried by their persisted client order ID, so that absence or timeout cannot trigger automatic resubmission.
22. As a user, I want exact cancellation approval and current provider order evidence, so that cancellation never applies to another order or stale intent.
23. As a user, I want ACK, fill and cancellation separated and fees settled exactly once, so that capacity is not released before broker truth.
24. As a user, I want private-stream gaps repaired with identity-bound REST reconciliation, so that a disconnected stream does not leave fictitious current state.
25. As a user, I want crash, restart, lock and wake to disarm and recover read-only, so that interrupted work is never replayed automatically.
26. As a user, I want account faults isolated and shared-policy changes to affect all bound accounts, so that safety and recovery have the correct scope.
27. As a user, I want keyboard and narrow-screen controls to retain all blockers, so that financial consent remains accessible and deliberate.
28. As a user, I want actual Live transactions performed only under a concrete separately approved plan, so that development consent is not trading consent.
29. As a reviewer, I want exact-SHA local, ordinary-native and real-provider evidence labelled separately, so that fixtures cannot close hosted acceptance.
30. As a reviewer, I want S28, S17 and physical S27 gates preserved, so that the scheduling exception does not waive release requirements.

## Implementation Decisions

- English RevC PRD, UI §14 and Backend §41–42 remain authoritative; synchronize financial, wire and evidence contracts in Chinese.
- Reuse the agreed single-ticket vertical-slice workflow and existing public UI → typed Control Plane → temporary SQLite/outbox seam with external secure-vault/HTTP/WS fakes. No hidden positive financial snapshot seeding. Positive financial dispatch later uses the real isolated authenticated child Gateway and loopback fake provider.
- Execute serially: (1) ordinary-account trading-state diagnostics and safety consumption; (2) configured Binance venue/rule/market evidence; (3) trusted Live PLACE/private-stream lifecycle and fault recovery; (4) complete ordinary-native/read-only acceptance and concrete authorized financial handoff. Publish only the current implementation ticket, then reassess the next complete slice after its review. The existing confirmed granularity/seam convention is retained.
- First slice reads public system status and signed account API trading status during the existing connection/probe/refresh path. Persist bounded typed evidence with local receipt time distinct from provider lock update time. An unlocked account and normal system response do not certify instrument liquidity, licence, complete permissions or Live readiness.
- Missing historical evidence, locks, maintenance and failed reads must never support Arm/PLACE. Recovery remains read-only and disarmed. Existing independent CANCEL/unknown-order reconciliation evidence paths must remain available under their existing guard contracts.
- Ordinary Binance host only; no Testnet fallback, alternate regional host or access bypass. Unsupported responses fail closed.
- S29 has shared implementation prerequisites S06/S08/S19/S21–S27; S28 is not a technical dependency. The unresolved physical S27 acceptance remains a release gate.

## Testing Decisions

- Exercise public connect/probe/refresh/get/list/reopen and existing financial guard commands, not private parser calls or directly seeded account rows.
- Record RED before GREEN for the first new external behavior. Cover normal, maintenance, account lock, missing/wrong-type/unknown flags, malformed provider times, stale/state-conflict results, recovery, persistence and environment isolation.
- Check endpoint/method/signature/secret boundaries at the fake external provider. Do not execute real financial requests for tests.
- Validate the actual React Accounts surface against the isolated real Rust Control Plane, including keyboard and narrow layouts; ordinary native evidence is distinct.
- Require sequential independent Standards then Spec reviews and current checks bound to delivery SHA. Complete S29 closure also requires authorized hosted lifecycle evidence, not just local test success.

## Out of Scope

Margin/futures/leverage, transfers/withdrawals/custody, arbitrary assets, implicit stablecoin parity, licence purchases, jurisdiction bypass, Testnet hosted acceptance, Bitget S30, changes to S28 gates, and automatic merge to main.

## Further Notes

Starting dev SHA: fe20d0aae1c0eea9df43c1e24f32199a92ff30b9. The user selected S29 on 2026-10-07; S28 remains OPEN. S29 remains OPEN until all listed behaviors and real-provider gates are satisfied.

Primary API references checked 2026-10-07: [Binance Wallet account API](https://developers.binance.com/en/docs/catalog/core-trading-wallet/api/rest-api/account), [system status](https://developers.binance.com/en/docs/catalog/core-trading-wallet/api/rest-api/others), [Spot rules](https://developers.binance.com/en/docs/catalog/core-trading-spot-trading/api/rest-api/general), [Spot market streams](https://developers.binance.com/en/docs/catalog/core-trading-spot-trading/api/ws-streams/~). Endpoint-specific inspection is repeated when implementing each later slice; unexamined API behavior is not a delivery claim.

## Problem Statement

Trade names missing dynamic order-count and position obligations but cannot show a current complete bounded account inventory behind them. Visible orders for one symbol, old account balances or rate-limit counters cannot establish exchange-wide open-order capacity or the base asset exposure of an immutable Proposal. Users need observed inputs, their coverage and the remaining qualification gap before reviewing consent.

Provide one complete read-only vertical slice: select an existing ordinary Binance Live BTC/USDT or ETH/USDT Proposal, explicitly collect only its required exact-account capacity inputs through fixed authenticated GETs, and show bounded typed inventory/count/position observations with original provenance and unresolved completeness in Trade/current and captured review. This source prerequisite does not itself qualify dynamic financial rules, funding, Arm, consent or dispatch. A later owning evaluator/preflight must establish applicable execution qualifications; no positive authority seed is introduced here.

## User Stories

1. As a user, I want capacity observations bound to my saved immutable Proposal and exact account, so that another account's inventory cannot qualify my intent.
2. As a user, I want required inputs derived from actual active scoped rules, so that unrelated account reads are not made.
3. As a user, I want one-symbol and exchange-wide counts kept distinct, so that unseen foreign-symbol orders are not dropped.
4. As a user, I want interval unfilled-order counters kept separate from open-order filter counts, so that an unrelated API counter cannot replace inventory.
5. As a user, I want observed ordinary, algorithmic, iceberg and list coverage explained, so that unknown classifications cannot be silently counted as zero.
6. As a user, I want list identity and missing pending legs represented, so that advanced orders outside TradeX cannot hide reserved capacity.
7. As a user, I want original free and locked BASE balances separated from open BUY exposure, so that holdings and pending purchases are not confused.
8. As a user, I want original quantity and executed quantity preserved where relevant, so that partial fills cannot be silently converted into guessed capacity.
9. As a user, I want foreign-symbol/asset uncertainty visible, so that a ticker prefix cannot invent authoritative asset membership.
10. As a user, I want source coverage and response bounds shown, so that a truncated, duplicate or malformed inventory is not a complete account observation.
11. As a user, I want provider update times separated from local collection receipts, so that last state change is not impersonated as snapshot freshness.
12. As a user, I want separate HTTP observations labelled as non-atomic, so that receipt proximity does not manufacture a provider snapshot guarantee.
13. As a user, I want explicit refresh and sanitized recovery, so that missing/auth/quota/deadline failures retire current inputs without losing the explanation.
14. As a user, I want source/account/credential/Proposal/session/time changes and late responses rejected, so that stale reads cannot attach to new intent.
15. As a user, I want captured review outcomes and digests retained without raw private account inventory, so that history does not become a refreshed current read.
16. As a user, I want units, unresolved qualification and independent financial blockers visible by keyboard and at narrow widths, so that observing capacity never implies approval.
17. As a reviewer, I want genuine public RED/GREEN and exact-byte local/build/UI/serial-review evidence, so that hidden snapshot seeds cannot close this source prerequisite or the full parent.

## Implementation Decisions

- Retain the confirmed single-ticket public React → actual typed Rust Control Plane → owned temporary SQLite/outbox → external fake vault/HTTP/WS seam. Reuse immutable Proposal, exact selected account/key ownership, current rule metadata, trusted clock, provider read scheduler/budgets and current/captured Trade explanations. No new account configuration, renderer credential/host/symbol/count/balance input, background scan or standalone financial authority model.
- Add trusted `trade.spot_capacity.get` and explicit CAS `trade.spot_capacity.refresh` operations identifying only workspace/stored Proposal/current state. Backend derives actual required purpose, exact account/remote UID/credential version, canonical BTC/ETH/USDT, actual rule scopes/material and workspace/source/policy/session/time bindings. Collecting no required purpose must perform no unnecessary private read. Bound concurrent ownership/slots/generation/deadline and reject foreign or changed state before publication.
- Use only fixed ordinary Binance authenticated USER_DATA GET routes and existing signed/vault/zeroization boundary. Account information supplies exact identity and original relevant BASE free/locked fields. Full-account open orders are necessary when exchange-wide or shared-asset coverage is required; a symbol-only subset is never complete for these purposes. Open order-list inventory is collected only for actual list/leg completeness needs. Default proposed route costs are clock2, account20, full openOrders80 and openOrderList6, rechecked against official contracts before implementation. Charge genuine signed-account UID/IP budgets, with no quota reset or public UID fiction; defer on shared cooldown, preserve remaining deadline and never hold CP lock across vault/network I/O.
- Keep interval unfilled-order counters, request-rate/ORDERS limits, open-order filter inventory and local reservations as distinct concepts. The rateLimit/order endpoint is not an open-order inventory substitute; do not call it for this source slice. No order test/probe, PLACE/CANCEL/amend/list creation, listen-key mutation or financial authorization occurs.
- Parse bounded original JSON types, duplicate fields, UID/symbol/order/list identities, original exact decimals, statuses/types/side/iceberg observations and timestamps before projection. Proposed hard limits:512KiB per response,1000 account open-order rows,256 open-list rows and1024 balance rows; bounds are validation limits, never truncation. Reject oversized/ambiguous/duplicate/non-open/malformed collections or preserve a specific incomplete status; never drop rows to report complete coverage. Preserve int64 identities/counts as exact strings across IPC. Unknown active fields/statuses/classifications remain unresolved, not zero or ordinary by default.
- Project bounded coverage/counts and selected BASE balance/exposure observations, not raw private inventory. Clearly distinguish exact observed values from any conservative bound and unavailable asset attribution. No inferred foreign-symbol BASE mapping, USDT/USD parity, assumed advanced-list leg state or guessed remaining quantity. A partly filled/open BUY ambiguity must remain explicit until an owning execution contract resolves its semantics. - A full returned array establishes only completeness of that particular bounded response under its documented endpoint contract. Separate account/orders/lists reads have no documented common atomic watermark here; expose read windows, original account/order/list update times where supplied, absent aggregate provider observation time and quality READ_ONLY_SPOT_CAPACITY. Provider clock samples remain clock observations. Never relabel a last update as current provider snapshot time or claim complete atomic capacity. Contradictory list/leg/identity/time observations remain unresolved.
- Fresh get/cached history never renews a collection receipt. An actual explicitly authenticated re-read creates a separately identified collection observation; keep that observation's original first receipts and material digest. Expiry, account/credential/source/rule/market/policy/Proposal/workspace/session/clock changes retire current eligibility, and failed refresh clears current inputs while retaining only sanitized last-observation explanations. Reopen restores configuration/history only and performs no implicit private collection.
- Owning dynamic rule evaluation remains UNAVAILABLE/DYNAMIC_INPUTS_NOT_EXECUTION_QUALIFIED in this source slice, including when complete bounded observations arrive. Collecting inputs cannot upgrade MARKET_DATA_USE/data rights, key permissions/health, quote/liquidity, fees/FX, funding/reservations, Arm, consent or immediate Gateway preflight. Preserve exact independent CANCEL/reconciliation paths. A later synchronized contract must distinguish applicable plain-intent capacities and authenticated execution qualification; do not pre-solve it with a hidden positive snapshot.
- Current and captured UI expose identity, actual required purpose, units, exact versus incomplete coverage/classification, non-atomic quality, original times versus receipts, age/failure and explicit read-only recovery. Captured risk/review history stores only approved bounded aggregate observations/digests, not raw account/balance/order/list responses or runtime caches; it has no refresh/polling controller. Paired English/Chinese financial, IPC and interaction contracts must be synchronized during implementation.

Cover genuinely unnecessary reads and distinguish interval rate counters from open inventory. Financial rule qualification stays unavailable in every positive source scenario.
- Test account/credential/source/rule/Proposal/policy/workspace/session/time changes, failed refresh/expiry/reopen, late read/deadline/cancellation, shared UID/IP caps and418/429 cooldown without reset. Assert no global CP lock across I/O, order probe/mutation, raw private inventory persistence or overall approval/reservation.

Part of #1 — [Wayfinder] 完整构建 TradeX v1.0 RevC
Related acceptance parents: #113 and #115. Quote implementation #116 remains OPEN.

## Problem Statement

The configured Alpaca quote/Hot producer is delivered on dev, but a quote alone cannot support Trading 212 Live approval, Prepare or Gateway dispatch. Ordinary builds still lack independently current calendar, corporate-action, exact execution-provider tradability and any required transaction-grade FX observations. Trading 212 public API does not expose complete key-scope introspection; successful account reads leave permissions UNVERIFIED. Historical fixture authority is not evidence that these production prerequisites exist.

## Solution

Complete production financial prerequisites serially, using the existing authoritative Control Plane and public Settings/Markets/Trade surfaces. Start with the already selected Alpaca XNAS calendar producer, then resolve corporate-action and Trading 212 instrument evidence, then the FX routes actually required by the immutable intent and capacity policy. Return to the existing quote and Trading 212 acceptance tickets only when their gates are satisfied. Keep unsupported capabilities visibly blocked and distinguish implementation checks, provider-hosted reads, and specifically authorized financial execution.

## User Stories

1. As a user, I want the existing quote ticket kept open during prerequisite work, so that its missing positive acceptance is not lost.
2. As a user, I want one prerequisite implemented and reviewed at a time, so that each change has concrete acceptance evidence.
3. As a user, I want complete key permissions distinguished from successful read capabilities, so that account connectivity cannot enable Live Arm.
4. As a user, I want unsupported Trading 212 scope introspection recorded as an external capability gap, so that another key or manual acknowledgement is not presented as a remedy that verifies scope.
5. As a user, I want the chosen calendar credential and its exact provider environment visible, so that data reads never try another host or saved key implicitly.
6. As a user, I want to reuse an eligible securely saved Alpaca credential explicitly, so that secrets remain in the native vault.
7. As a user, I want calendar replacement and disconnection to invalidate prior observations, so that old facts cannot authorize new work.
8. As a user, I want authenticated XNAS calendar boundaries for canonical AAPL/MSFT, so that another venue cannot determine their regular session.
9. As a user, I want regular, extended, closed, holiday and early-close boundaries determined from provider UTC timestamps, so that local weekday assumptions or DST arithmetic do not invent market hours.
10. As a user, I want calendar source, first receipt time, exact requested coverage and stable content version shown, so that freshness and provenance are inspectable.
11. As a user, I want absent provider observation timestamps left absent, so that scheduled opening times or HTTP receipt times are not mislabeled as provider observation time.
12. As a user, I want stale, malformed, incomplete, mismatched or unavailable calendar evidence to block, so that the last readable session is not reused for execution.
13. As a user, I want clock discontinuity, reopen, workspace switch and credential replacement to retire observations, so that a previous process session is never current authority.
14. As a user, I want each OD-005 capability shown separately, so that working calendar access does not imply corporate-action, halt or historical-adjustment coverage.
15. As a user, I want corporate-action records tied to canonical identity, effective date, source identity and bounded coverage, so that missing or ambiguous actions remain unknown.
16. As a user, I want provider processing delays and incomplete corporate-action records exposed, so that an empty response does not certify no pending action.
17. As a user, I want historical adjustment status independent of action metadata, so that downloaded events do not silently mark prices adjusted.
18. As a user, I want execution-provider instrument identity and tradability checked for my exact selected account and venue, so that an Alpaca asset flag cannot authorize a Trading 212 instrument.
19. As a user, I want unsupported Trading 212 halt/tradability guarantees recorded explicitly, so that membership in a metadata list is not overstated.
20. As a user, I want FX requirements derived from actual instrument, wallet, workspace and policy currencies, so that optional conversions are not invented and required conversions are not skipped.
21. As a user, I want verified current transaction-grade FX with exact decimals and dual timestamps where needed, so that daily ECB informational rates or stablecoin parity cannot satisfy execution.
22. As a user, I want pre-Arm risk preview to show each independently satisfied or missing gate, so that successful data reads do not imply approval authority.
23. As a user, I want material evidence changes invalidating approvals and rechecked at consumption and dispatch, so that current data never retroactively refreshes old consent.
24. As a keyboard and narrow-window user, I want deliberate source controls and legible remediation at 390/768/1280px, so that refreshing or pressing Enter cannot authorize a financial operation.
25. As a user, I want bounded HTTP, quota handling, vault access and cancellation outside the Control Plane lock, so that unavailable data cannot stall unrelated actions.
26. As a user, I want independent serial Standards and Spec review and exact-SHA validation, so that local PASS and external gaps are reported separately.
27. As a user, I want real provider reads kept read-only, so that a new source never probes permissions by submitting or cancelling orders.
28. As a user, I want actual financial acceptance to require a concrete separately approved order and cancel plan, so that general development authorization is not transaction consent.

## Implementation Decisions

- Keep the existing quote implementation and its acceptance parents OPEN. The user explicitly authorized the prerequisite sequencing exception on 2026-10-01; this does not waive any acceptance criterion.
- Use the existing versioned typed Settings, MarketDetail, immutable Proposal, risk, approval, capacity, Gateway and durable audit contracts. Only the Control Plane owns eligibility. No renderer/model evidence assertions, arbitrary URLs, manual permission attestation, hidden authority seeding or synthetic market snapshots in ordinary builds.
- First deliver an independently configured read-only Alpaca calendar vertical slice. Reuse an explicitly selected eligible saved Alpaca Paper credential on its fixed Paper host; Live-host support requires an explicit supported selection, never automatic fallback. This source is distinct from broker execution and quote-feed entitlement. Borrowed account keys are never deleted by calendar disconnect.
- Use current official v3 MIC calendar with XNAS and explicit UTC, a bounded date window and strict canonical venue matching. The response is non-paginated scheduled data; regular/extended boundaries come from the response, not a local exchange calendar. Missing/incoherent bounds fail closed. Provider observation time is optional and never invented.
- Calendar observations are process-scoped, source/version/account/session-bound and short-lived (maximum 30 trusted seconds for execution). Preserve first receipt; polling projection does not renew freshness. Content version is derived deterministically from validated coverage and material schedule fields. Reopen, clock discontinuity, selection changes, failed refresh and disconnected credentials retire eligibility.
- Expose independent typed capability results for OD-005. Overall source availability must not imply unimplemented corporate-action/halt/history coverage. Calendar alone may satisfy only its matching risk check; all other financial guards remain unchanged.
- Corporate-action and exact Trading 212 tradability producer design follows current official contract research. Alpaca warns of processing delays; its current corporate-action endpoint is process-date based. An empty list cannot prove no announced action, and membership in Trading 212 instrument metadata cannot prove unrestricted current tradability or halt absence. Unsupported positive proof remains an external blocker, not a synthetic producer.
- Scope FX to genuinely required currency routes and the existing exact-decimal freshness/quality checks. ECB daily reference data remains informational. Transaction-grade provider selection/entitlement is a later explicit source decision if no already supported provider supplies the required contract.
- Trading 212 complete key/IP scope remains UNVERIFIED because the reviewed official API has no introspection operation. No successful GET, checkbox, screenshot, order probe or key replacement promotes it to VERIFIED. Preserve the normative Live Arm requirement; a future product-contract change requires explicit user agreement and synchronized normative documents, not implementation inference.
- Record native blocking edges only for real prerequisites. Serial execution order is not itself a technical dependency. Never create an acceptance-parent/child dependency cycle.

## Testing Decisions

- Reuse the already accepted highest public seam: Settings/Accounts/Markets/Trade UI → typed real Rust Control Plane → disposable SQLite/outbox → external fake secure vault and loopback HTTP/WebSocket. For a later allowed financial positive path, use the existing authenticated independent real-child Gateway → loopback fake provider → durable UI projection. No new hidden authority seam.

- Exact provider-hosted calendar access is separate from SIP entitlement, corporate-action completeness, Trading 212 verified permission, execution-grade FX and financial positive acceptance. Missing external capabilities remain BLOCKED_EXTERNAL/IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED with precise reasons.

## Out of Scope

- Changing VERIFIED permission requirements, manual authority attestations, automatic Arm, financial permission probes, real provider mutations, paid-plan purchase, order-type expansion, crypto Live acceptance, blind retry or uncertain reservation release.
- Closing the quote or Trading 212 parent based on prerequisite-only tests, claiming delayed/IEX coverage as eligible SIP, or marking historical data adjusted from event presence.

Part of #113 — [Spec] 验证 Trading 212 Live 可信执行（S28）; Wayfinder #1.

# S28 follow-up — configured Alpaca production quotes

Status: **IMPLEMENTATION_IN_PROGRESS**, 2026-09-30. Start reference: `dev@dc4c350397bbe500983b47fdfd5d1c3af2f20455`. Parent: [Verify trusted Trading 212 Live execution](https://github.com/kaiqiangh/tradex/issues/113). The prior local Market approval child is closed; parent acceptance remains OPEN.

## Problem Statement

The ordinary application cannot consume the already selected OD-001 source. Its credentialed probe always returns BLOCKED_EXTERNAL, no source configuration can be saved, and ordinary market detail returns no quote even when a source entry is AVAILABLE. Market Explorer's Hot detail has no production subscription. The completed synthetic approval chain therefore cannot establish production quote readiness. An Alpaca Paper broker link does not establish feed entitlement or coverage.

## Solution

Deliver one complete source-configuration-to-quote slice: explicitly configure independently scoped Alpaca market-data access, verify the selected feed through the provider, fetch on demand for Census/Warm and maintain an active Hot subscription, publish authoritative exact quotes with their provenance, and consume those same observations through existing market and approval/risk surfaces. Source access never grants financial authority. Other S28 prerequisites remain separately visible and unresolved.

## User Stories

1. As a user, I want the selected OD-001 provider explained in Settings, so that I understand which feed supplies my quotes.
2. As a user, I want to explicitly select an existing Alpaca credential reference, so that I can reuse my own saved key without displaying or copying it.
3. As a user, I want a native secure flow for a dedicated data key, so that a data source need not create a trading account.
4. As a user, I want workspace-scoped versioned source configuration, so that another workspace or stale screen cannot change my source.
5. As a user, I want IEX, SIP and delayed SIP chosen explicitly, so that the provider's default feed cannot silently change coverage.
6. As a user, I want the selected feed verified with authenticated read-only requests, so that an account connection or checked box cannot invent entitlement.
7. As a user, I want denied SIP access explained without automatic IEX fallback, so that a limited feed is not presented as complete coverage.
8. As a user, I want delayed and single-venue quotes visibly labeled, so that they cannot authorize an unsupported Live target.
9. As a user, I want source, feed, coverage, symbol, venue and precise provider/receipt timestamps retained, so that I can inspect the quote used by risk.
10. As a user, I want exact decimal prices and documented BASE depth units, so that floating-point or round-lot assumptions cannot change my approval.
11. As a user, I want bid/ask venues preserved separately from the instrument's listing and execution target, so that consolidated prices are not misrepresented as one venue's book.
12. As a user, I want invalid, crossed, stale, future or unsupported-condition quotes rejected, so that malformed provider data cannot become trusted evidence.
13. As a user, I want Census/Warm refresh only on demand, so that the application does not subscribe to the whole universe.
14. As a user, I want Hot quotes for the currently viewed instrument, so that Market Explorer receives actual updates while I am viewing it.
15. As a user, I want navigation, disconnect and workspace close to release subscriptions, so that credentials and resources do not leak across views.
16. As a user, I want failed authentication, transport errors and quota cooldowns shown as degraded/stale, so that old prices never remain execution-ready.
17. As a user, I want source/feed/credential changes and reconnects to invalidate old quote consent, so that prior approval cannot authorize changed evidence.
18. As a user, I want reopen to retain my source selection but require fresh verification, so that stored configuration does not restore Live authority.
19. As a user, I want bounded network work outside the Control Plane lock, so that data traffic cannot starve reconciliation or trusted commands.
20. As a user, I want Settings, Market Explorer and approval reasons usable at390/768/1280px with keyboard access, so that I can connect, inspect and remediate the source.
21. As a user, I want quote ticks kept in memory rather than a new durable tick archive, so that the MVP retention policy remains explicit.
22. As a user, I want raw secrets and provider error bodies absent from IPC, persistence and logs, so that source setup does not expose credentials.
23. As a user, I want source disconnect to preserve a reused broker key/account, so that managing market data cannot delete another connection.
24. As a user, I want actual provider reads separated from fake-provider tests, so that fixture success cannot imply my data subscription is active.
25. As a user, I want permission/calendar/tradability/corporate-action/FX gates still enforced, so that working quotes alone cannot arm or execute a real order.

## Implementation Decisions

- Reuse the existing secure vault, source catalog, versioned command/job pattern, provider scheduling, market projections, TimeService, approval digests and UI surfaces. The new durable source configuration owns a generation/version and contains only metadata and an opaque credential reference. Secrets stay in the native vault. Explicit reuse does not duplicate ownership of an account's vault item.
- Add typed configure/disconnect lifecycle and sanitized source connection/verification projections. Configure has explicit credential-reference selection or native dedicated-credential setup; the ordinary renderer and Agent cannot submit a market observation, entitlement attestation or arbitrary provider URL.
- Fixed Alpaca data HTTPS/WSS endpoints and exact supported paths only, redirects disabled, explicit feed and canonical symbol mapping, bounded bodies/frames/timeouts, read-only GET and subscription traffic. No broker POST/DELETE or privileged Gateway action belongs to this adapter.
- Provider-confirmed access to the explicitly requested feed establishes that feed's technical availability only. Freshness, coverage, licence/retention restrictions and financial readiness remain distinct. IEX is single-venue realtime; delayed SIP remains delayed; SIP permission failure never changes feed implicitly. No plan purchase, agreement acceptance or permission expansion is automated.
- Keep quote feed/coverage and bid/ask exchange evidence distinct from listing/execution venue. The authoritative coverage-aware eligibility contract must be documented in both languages before implementation; do not relabel IEX as XNAS or a consolidated NBBO as a single-venue order book. Unknown coverage/venue mapping stays unavailable for execution.
- Parse decimal tokens without floating-point conversion. Determine size units for the exact HTTP/stream endpoint from current authoritative evidence. The generic stream page still describes round lots, but the later official CTA/UTP changelog states that quote sizes became share counts from2025-11-03. For current SIP CTA/UTP quotes, preserve those exact share counts as BASE depth without multiplying by100. This is a feed/date-specific contract; do not extrapolate it to IEX or historical data. BASE depth for any other supported path requires verified applicable units/conversion; unresolved mappings remain explicitly unavailable rather than fabricated depth. Quote prices may still be presented honestly. Financial-positive acceptance cannot be claimed from unverified depth.
- Validate provider symbol, requested feed, supported quote conditions, timestamp precision, source/config generation and instrument identity. Use current TimeService to age quotes on every read and approval phase. Changed prices/depth/provenance/source generation invalidate existing consent through the shared quote material, without weakening S28's exact slippage comparison.
- On-demand Census/Warm fetches and one active Hot stream per configured workspace/source respect quotas and provider connection limits; subscriptions cover requested supported symbols only. Hot navigation/reconnect uses generations so late frames cannot replace another instrument's/current credentials' observations. Reconnect is bounded, and backpressure/cooldown marks observations non-current.
- Persist configuration/audit metadata in SQLite; quotes and Hot buffers remain bounded memory. Reopen clears live verification/quote freshness and never restores an approval or ARMED state. Source disconnect clears its observations and subscriptions, preserving unrelated account/vault ownership.
- Preserve the existing canonical provider/receipt timestamp binding in risk/review digests. Reading an already accepted quote returns that same observation and its original receipt time; a repeated identical provider event does not refresh its freshness. A new provider timestamp, changed quote material or source/connection generation is new evidence and invalidates old consent. Snapshot identity includes those authoritative dimensions; a view collection time is not a provider event.
- WebSocket upgrade/connected is not authenticated access. Require the authenticated acknowledgement and the requested-symbol subscription acknowledgement before Hot is current. Handle HTTP status codes separately from stream protocol errors: stream402/404 are authentication failure/timeout,405 symbol limit,406 connection limit,407 slow client and409 insufficient subscription; stream403 means already authenticated, not HTTP Forbidden. Never infer entitlement from the public test stream or FAKEPACA.
- Maintain a single managed connection for the active workspace/source in the native process, with bounded auth/subscription deadlines, frames and buffer. Connection-limit errors from other applications remain visible and require cooldown/manual remediation; do not stop another application's connection or open concurrent retries. No wildcard symbol subscription is part of this slice.
- Hot updates use typed ephemeral subscription generations/sequences; do not fabricate a SQLite domain sequence or persist quote ticks to make replay appear supported. On reconnect, mark old observations stale and require a fresh authenticated/subscribed stream plus actual provider observations. Late/older responses cannot replace current evidence; conflicting unordered observations remain unavailable rather than guessed current.
- Synchronize shared IPC generation, English/Chinese Backend/Frontend/UI contracts, requirement evidence and operational documentation. Do not mark FR-016/AC-010 or the parent VERIFIED on this local slice.

## Testing Decisions

Continue the previously agreed highest seam: public Settings → Market Explorer/Order Drafts UI → versioned Rust Control Plane → temporary SQLite and existing secure-vault test boundary → fixed-endpoint fake Alpaca HTTP/WebSocket → authoritative quote/risk projection. Provider bytes enter through the actual adapter; no direct fixture snapshot or renderer entitlement override can stand in for this path. This is one outer integration seam, with fault scenarios varying its provider responses.

Prove configure/reuse/dedicated ownership, exact feed/path/symbol/header routing without exposing values, provider-positive quote/Hot update/reopen and UI provenance, source disconnect/credential change/late response generations, IEX/delayed versus SIP coverage, precise size normalization when proved, and unavailable depth when it is not. Include401/403/429/cooldown, malformed/oversized/missing/crossed/nonpositive/future/stale quotes, unsupported conditions, navigation/stream reconnect and no replay or Live auto-Arm. Assert actual externally visible quote identity, source status, risk outcomes, request counts and durable source generation; do not mirror helper internals.

Run meaningful RED at the public seam for today's missing configured producer, related checks, schema/type consistency, one final serial full suite, ordinary desktop build,390/768/1280px UI, and independent serial Standards then Spec against the captured start SHA. Real read-only validation uses the user's explicitly configured source via its existing service; missing credentials/entitlement or closed-market freshness remains unverified/external. No fixture, provider default, stale retained account state or subscription price implies paid access or financial authority.

## Out of Scope

This ticket does not complete production calendar/halts/corporate actions, execution-provider tradability, transaction-grade FX, safe broker-permission attestation or real order/cancel acceptance. Those remain original S28 requirements and subsequent serial work, not waived requirements. OD-002 historical ingestion, all-market instrument discovery, crypto/news/fundamentals adapters, persistent Warm subscriptions/universe-wide Hot streaming, signed packaging and S33–S35 are separate work. S17 Paper and S27 physical sleep/wake remain open. No main PR before complete map acceptance.

## Further Notes

Authoritative references checked2026-09-30:

- [Alpaca subscriptions/authentication](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/docs/about-market-data-api): Basic equity realtime coverage is IEX; full US-exchange realtime requires the applicable subscription.
- [Latest quotes](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/reference/stocklatestquotes-1): explicit feed/currency and fixed latest-quote endpoint; provider default varies with subscription.
- [Market Data FAQ](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/docs/market-data-faq): latest SIP endpoints require subscription; symbol/timestamp truth and limits remain important.
- [CTA/UTP size-unit change](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/changelog/marketdata-bid-and-ask-size-display-change): dated2025-10-30, effective2025-11-03, CTA/UTP quote sizes are shares rather than round lots; this supersedes the generic page for that feed/date scope.
- [Real-time stock data](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/docs/real-time-stock-pricing-data): fixed stream feeds, authentication/subscription and raw bid/ask venue/round-lot fields.
- [WebSocket protocol](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/docs/streaming-market-data): authentication within10seconds, subscription acknowledgement, finite connection/symbol limits and stream-specific error codes; test stream is not production entitlement.
- [Exchange codes](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/reference/stockmetaexchanges-1), [quote conditions](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/reference/stockmetaconditions-1): provider metadata must be mapped deliberately.

This draft carries forward S06's selected source and PRD §§31–35/FR-011/FR-012/FR-057, UI §14 and Backend §§41–42. It changes no production capability until the proposed implementation ticket is approved, implemented and verified.

This closes the source-inspection gap without depending on a successful permission/arming gate owned by the original S28 parent. Single-ticket granularity and all existing financial gates remain intact.

## Problem Statement

Trading 212 Live read-only account recovery is working, and the trusted approval, capacity reservation, authenticated Order Gateway, unknown-result reconciliation and cancellation seams exist. Their individual fixture results do not yet prove a complete Trading 212 Live workflow. Current source inspection also finds an actual integration mismatch: Live market approval requires an immutable maximum authorized spend/value, while the shared Trading 212 request builder rejects every Proposal carrying maximumSpend. Production permission scope, realtime market provenance, calendar/corporate-action evidence and real-money acceptance remain separately unproven.

## Solution

Complete and verify the Trading 212 Live path through the existing authoritative Control Plane. Preserve account-scoped Arm, exact immutable consent, current risk/market/time/account evidence, atomic consumption/reservation, one durable dispatch boundary, fixed Live routing, broker acknowledgement distinct from fills, query-first unknown recovery, exact cancellation approval and durable audit. Resolve contract mismatches without weakening safety checks or presenting unavailable provider capabilities as ready. Record local contract/fault evidence separately from actual provider reads and any specifically authorized real-money transaction.

## User Stories

1. As a Trading 212 Live user, I want my selected connection and exact remote account bound to every Proposal and approval, so that another account or environment cannot receive it.
2. As a user, I want readable health, permissions and missing-evidence reasons, so that a successful account read does not falsely imply Live readiness.
3. As a user, I want unknown or dangerous API permission scope to remain blocked, so that review acknowledgement cannot substitute for verified authority.
4. As a user, I want a separate account-scoped explicit Arm after current reconciliation, so that restored connectivity never restores consent.
5. As a user, I want the canonical supported instrument, venue and BASE quantity checked, so that unsupported order forms are never silently converted.
6. As a user, I want exact decimal buy/sell quantities and limit prices preserved, so that float rounding cannot alter my order.
7. As a user, I want only supported Market DAY and Limit DAY/GTC forms offered by the established order contract, so that provider limitations are explicit.
8. As a user, I want market orders disabled by default and still subject to configured policy, fresh quotes and a positive maximum authorized spend/value, so that enabling a policy cannot remove transaction-level limits.
9. As a user, I want the maximum authorized spend/value retained in the immutable approval and reservation even when it is not a broker request field, so that serialization cannot discard the local financial bound or reject an otherwise supported exact intent.
10. As a user, I want complete source/provider/received timestamps, venue, realtime entitlement and freshness displayed and revalidated, so that delayed or missing data cannot authorize execution.
11. As a user, I want trusted time, market session, tradability, corporate actions and any required FX checked, so that an unknown or stale input fails closed.
12. As a user, I want material edits and stale account/policy/market versions to invalidate approval, so that old consent cannot authorize a changed order.
13. As a user, I want approval consumed and native-asset capacity reserved atomically, so that competing work cannot reuse funds.
14. As a user, I want only the authenticated independent Gateway to perform one exact fixed-Live-host mutation after durable SUBMITTING, so that models and renderer requests have no financial authority.
15. As a user, I want authentication, identity, quota and preflight failures to stop before mutation, so that broker rejection or capability changes cannot redirect/replay work.
16. As a user, I want acknowledgement distinguished from fill, partial-fill and terminal state, so that accepted submission is never presented as a completed trade.
17. As a user, I want ambiguous submission to retain UNKNOWN_RECONCILING and its reservation, so that timeout, empty history or similar Trading 212 orders never prove absence or justify retry.
18. As a user, I want refresh and exact cancellation separately reviewed and approved, so that cancellation acknowledgement does not release remaining commitments before provider truth.
19. As a user, I want reopen, disarm and model failure to preserve the audit chain without replay, so that the trusted control plane remains usable during recovery.
20. As a keyboard user, I want order identity, safety reasons, consent and remediation readable at 390/768/1280px with deliberate approval controls, so that Enter never implicitly authorizes a financial operation.
21. As a user, I want real-account reads, synthetic financial tests and an explicitly authorized real-money order clearly separated in acceptance evidence, so that fixtures never imply provider-hosted execution passed.

## Implementation Decisions

- Reuse the existing versioned Trade commands, immutable Proposal/FinancialApproval, RiskDecision, ExecutionReservation/Attempt, account-health projections, SQLite/outbox and Gateway session/grant path. No second financial authority or arbitrary provider URL command.
- Correct the Trading 212 Live maximumSpend mismatch only at its shared request-validation boundary and trace all callers. The value remains part of the immutable financial intent and conservative local capacity checks; the broker request keeps the official supported fields only. Do not claim that Trading 212 guarantees a provider-enforced market-price ceiling.
- Preserve Demo behavior and fixed environment routing. BASE buy quantities are positive; SELL quantities are encoded negative only at the provider boundary. Limit uses DAY or GOOD_TILL_CANCEL; Market uses DAY and extendedHours=false. Unsupported form, malformed/absent required bound or incompatible fields fail explicitly.
- Preserve canonical instrument/account identity, primary-account-currency limitations, verified permissions, fresh realtime provenance, trusted TimeService, calendar/tradability/corporate-action and required FX guards at approval/consumption/dispatch. Missing producers or entitlement are implementation/external gaps to document and resolve; never use fixture data in ordinary desktop builds.
- Successful account reads establish read capabilities only. No permission attestation shortcut, synthetic VERIFIED scope, automatic Arm, credentials in renderer/logs, provider-write probe, blind retry or uncertain reservation release.
- Use existing account, proposal, approval, preparation, provider observation and cancellation surfaces. If contract corrections require IPC/doc changes, synchronize both language editions and generated types.
- S27 physical OS sleep/wake is explicitly deferred by the user on 2026-09-30 and does not block starting this slice; it remains unverified before final map acceptance. S17 external Paper acceptance remains separately open.

## Testing Decisions

- Reuse the pre-agreed highest seam: primary Trade UI → real versioned Rust Control Plane → temporary SQLite/outbox → authenticated real-child Gateway → loopback fake provider → durable UI projection. Test externally visible identity/state/request counts rather than duplicated implementation.
- First reproduce the maximumSpend mismatch with the existing provider/Proposal seam; then prove the approved Market DAY intent can reach exactly one proper POST while its immutable approval and reservation keep their local maximum. Include buy/sell decimals, missing/invalid bounds, Limit variants and unchanged Demo rejection.
- Cover disarmed/unverified permission/no configured policy, delayed/stale/missing quote, clock uncertainty, unavailable calendar/tradability/FX, changed material inputs, insufficient capacity, duplicate prepare/dispatch, cross-account/environment and expired grants. Rejection must not send a provider mutation or create unsafe authority.
- Reuse broker fault cases: 401/403/429, changed remote identity, rejected/unknown responses, lost acknowledgement, duplicate activation, persistence failure and reopen; assert no replay, no fabricated fills/absence or reservation release.
- Verify exact-order CANCEL with separate intent/approval and provider-truth convergence; retain existing S25/S26 rules. Run related checks, one final full suite, desktop build, schema/traceability/diff checks and serial independent Standards then Spec reviews against the captured start SHA.
- Perform real read-only native verification only through existing secure account/market services; retain sanitized time/scope/status/count evidence. A real-money test is allowed only after safety gates pass and the user approves a concrete reviewed account/instrument/side/type/quantity/price/maximum and cancel plan. General build/test authorization is not transaction consent.
- Record BLOCKED_EXTERNAL or IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED for missing entitlement, permission proof or transaction consent. Keep this parent OPEN until its provider-hosted acceptance is actually supported; closing a local implementation child does not close the parent.

## Out of Scope

- Binance/Bitget Live completion, Alpaca Paper external gate, Demo/Testnet expansion, new order types, auto-Arm/replay, amend/replace, unattended strategy trading or generic provider frameworks.
- Overriding missing/dangerous permission, quote/licensing, calendar/corporate-action or FX evidence; purchasing a data plan without user authorization.
- Actual OS sleep/wake deferred in S27, S33 full-app regression, S34 signed packaging, S35 final release and main merge.

## Further Notes

Normative authority: PRD §§9.2, 15–16, 20–21, 25.2, 33–35 and acceptance AC-010/financial invariants; UI Spec F1–F11 and §14; Backend shared IPC/Live authority contracts including §§41.30–41.35. Tracking ownership: FR-016 / AC-010 plus shared requirements retained by their existing slices.

Official Trading 212 Public API v0 rechecked 2026-09-30: https://docs.trading212.com/api and https://docs.trading212.com/_bundle/api.json?download= . OpenAPI SHA-256: a272f70a713fa9f2f906e9b4be12136c9d5d63d7f9f48562e939aa35c4fc041d. The reference distinguishes Demo/Live hosts, signed quantity, non-idempotent submission, primary-currency execution, supported request fields and accepted-cancellation versus terminal truth. No broker maximumSpend field is defined.

title: [Spec] 验证 Trading 212 Live 可信执行（S28）

body:
Part of #1 — [Wayfinder] 完整构建 TradeX v1.0 RevC

## Problem Statement

TradeX already disarms Live accounts at safety boundaries, protects possibly submitted executions as `UNKNOWN_RECONCILING`, and keeps model inference outside the trusted execution authority. The remaining gap is coordinated recovery: after process restart, sleep/resume, authentication failure, or private-stream loss, connected Live accounts need to regain trusted time, provider observations, and reconciliation before becoming healthy for new execution. Provider budgets also need to keep execution reconciliation and account refresh ahead of research/history work without unbounded queues. Until that lifecycle is complete, recovery can remain manual or inconsistent, while the account UI may not explain which scope is blocked or why.

## Solution

Complete the S27 recovery lifecycle for supported Live accounts. Reuse S22 disarm, S24 dispatch-boundary, and S25 unknown-order evidence rules. Startup, resume, and reconnect begin from a disarmed/degraded state; restore provider time and connectivity; reconcile local execution projections against provider account state and orders; and report healthy only after required evidence is current. An account-specific fault affects that account, while a shared policy change affects every account bound to that policy. Never infer that a possibly dispatched order was canceled or absent, release its frozen reservation without sufficient evidence, replay a provider mutation, or restore prior Arm consent.

Route provider work through bounded priority classes: P0 execution reconciliation, P1 account refresh, P2 active market monitoring, and P3 research/history. Keep the trusted execution and reconciliation plane available when the model sidecar is unavailable; model failure pauses only agent turns and presents its existing remediation.

## User Stories

1. As a Live account user, I want every Live account to start disarmed after app restart, so that a previous session never silently restores execution consent.
2. As a user reopening a workspace, I want unresolved executions and open orders loaded from durable local state before recovery starts, so that TradeX does not lose work across a crash.
3. As a user, I want startup reconciliation to begin within the five-second target and compare local state with a fresh provider account snapshot, open orders, and recent order history, so that I can see recovery progressing promptly.
4. As a user, I want an account to remain unhealthy and unavailable for new Live execution until its required reconciliation succeeds, so that stale projections cannot authorize new orders.
5. As a user resuming from sleep, I want freshness invalidated, trusted time resynchronized, private streams reconnected, and provider state reconciled in order, so that a brief network or clock gap cannot make stale state appear healthy.
6. As a user whose authentication or private stream fails, I want only the affected account blocked and given a clear recovery reason, so that an unrelated healthy account is not unnecessarily disabled.
7. As a user affected by a shared risk-policy change, I want every account bound to that policy invalidated together, so that UI selection cannot narrow the safety scope.
8. As a user with an execution that may have crossed the durable dispatch boundary, I want the attempt and its reservation preserved as unknown until provider evidence resolves it, so that recovery never assumes the broker did nothing.
9. As a user, I want recovery to distinguish work stopped before dispatch from work that may have reached the provider, so that retry and remediation match the actual uncertainty.
10. As a Live account user, I want open and partially filled orders reconciled from provider facts after restart or stream loss, so that cumulative fills and remaining commitments remain accurate.
11. As a user, I want repeated, delayed, incomplete, or contradictory provider observations to remain idempotent and fail closed, so that recovery cannot duplicate fills or release capacity from missing data.
12. As a user with active execution recovery, I want P0 reconciliation requests to run ahead of research and history fetches, so that low-priority work cannot starve financial recovery.
13. As a user refreshing an account, I want P1 account refresh to precede market monitoring and history work, so that account readiness does not wait behind replaceable data requests.
14. As a user, I want provider work queues to stay bounded, coalesce replaceable quote/UI updates, and apply backpressure to lower-priority work, so that an outage or burst cannot exhaust local resources or stall the control plane.
15. As a user, I want model-sidecar outage, OAuth expiry, quota exhaustion, or port conflict to pause only model turns, so that approval, execution, cancellation, and reconciliation remain available.
16. As a user, I want account health and recovery states to show the affected account, last trusted observation, blocked reason, and available recovery action, so that I can tell what remains unsafe without relying on color alone.
17. As a user, I want recovery to require a separate explicit Arm after health returns, so that reconnection never revives old consent or sends a queued order automatically.
18. As a keyboard or assistive-technology user, I want recovery status and remediation to remain keyboard reachable, announced, and readable at narrow widths, so that safety actions remain usable during degraded states.

## Implementation Decisions

- Keep the Control Plane authoritative for account health, arming, policy scope, execution attempts, reservations, provider observations, and recovery eligibility. Renderer state and model output cannot mark an account healthy or authorize a retry.
- Reuse the existing workspace-open/resume, provider-job, exact Live reconciliation, account-health, outbox, and Order Gateway seams wherever they already express the required behavior. Do not create a second path for approvals, disarm, execution, or unknown-order resolution.
- Treat process restart, workspace reopen, OS sleep/session loss, private-stream loss, and authentication failure as explicit recovery triggers. Persist enough account-scoped recovery state to survive renderer and process restarts; clear a block only from fresh backend-owned evidence.
- Preserve established scope rules: restart/sleep/session loss and Disable All affect every Live account; an account fault affects that account; a shared policy change affects all bound accounts; UI selection never scopes recovery.
- On recovery, restore trusted TimeService confidence, reconnect supported private streams, and run bounded read-only account/order reconciliation before publishing healthy eligibility. Provider failures retain the last observation as stale/degraded and never fabricate an empty successful result.
- Keep attempts before dispatch distinguishable from `SUBMITTING`/possibly submitted attempts. Reuse S24's durable boundary and S25's provider-evidence rules; unknown attempts retain their active reservation and cannot be resent or manually resolved from an empty query.
- Apply one bounded provider-work scheduling policy with the PRD priority order P0 reconciliation, P1 account refresh, P2 active monitoring, P3 research/history. Low-priority work may be coalesced or delayed; it must not hold the SQLite/control-plane lock while waiting on provider I/O.
- Keep model quota and model-sidecar health separate from provider budgets and Live eligibility. A model error may stop an agent turn but cannot stop trusted monitoring, approval, cancellation, execution, or reconciliation paths.
- Render recovery through existing Account Health and K1–K5 recovery surfaces with canonical error codes, visible text, focus behavior, and responsive layouts. No implicit provider mutation, automatic Arm, or replay is exposed as remediation.
- Update the paired English and Simplified Chinese PRD/ARD/UI or implementation contracts only where the implementation makes a contract decision; keep shared IPC/event schemas, existing IDs, and evidence states synchronized.

## Testing Decisions

- Assert externally visible behavior at the highest existing seam: Control Plane public IPC plus the real desktop provider-job/recovery path, durable SQLite/outbox projections, exact fake-provider request counts, and the Account Health/recovery UI. Prefer existing seams over new test-only APIs.
- Use isolated temporary workspaces, synthetic credentials/accounts, deterministic clocks, local loopback fake providers/streams, and process restart/reopen tests. No real provider write is needed for local acceptance.
- Cover restart, workspace reopen, sleep/resume, stream loss, authentication failure, one-account versus shared-policy scope, and successful/failed/incomplete reconciliation. Assert the account remains disarmed until recovery completes and must be explicitly armed afterward.
- Exercise attempts stopped before dispatch and attempts persisted at/after `SUBMITTING`; assert no blind replay, unknown-state loss, fabricated absence, duplicate fill, or premature reservation release.
- Saturate lower-priority work and verify bounded memory/work counts, eventual P0/P1 progress, P2/P3 backpressure/coalescing, and responsive control-plane commands.
- Stop or invalidate the model sidecar while recovery and financial-control requests run; assert only the affected agent turn fails and account health/approval/execution/reconciliation outcomes remain available.
- Verify semantic status/remediation, keyboard flow, 390/768/1280 px layouts, no console errors, secret redaction, schema consistency, Rust/TypeScript checks, requirement traceability, and final diff checks. Record provider-hosted validation and S33 cross-surface regression separately.

## Out of Scope

- S17 Alpaca Paper external transaction verification and any provider-hosted order acceptance.
- Real provider order placement/cancellation during local development tests; this spec needs read-only recovery and synthetic provider mutations only where already required by an isolated fixture.
- Automatic re-arming, blind PLACE/CANCEL retries, broker cancellation as a recovery shortcut, or release of unknown reservations without sufficient evidence.
- New provider support, Demo/Testnet recovery expansion, S33 application-wide accessibility/regression, S34 packaging/signing, or the final `dev` → `main` PR.
- Reimplementing S22 arming, S24 dispatch authorization, S25 unknown-order evidence, or S21/S23 policy invalidation already owned by their completed slices.

## Further Notes

Normative sources: PRD §§15.1, 16.3, 48–50; UI Specification §§14.3 and K1–K5; Backend ARD §§37, 41–44, 47; Frontend ARD account-health and recovery contracts. S22, S24, and S25 evidence defines the existing safety boundaries; S33 remains the later full-app regression gate. The planned S27 acceptance row also covers provider-authenticated recovery, OS lifecycle evidence, bounded queues, and model-outage independence.

body:
# S17 完成 Alpaca Paper 交易生命周期

日期：2026-09-22

前置：S02 提供方连接、S13 OrderDraft/OrderProposal、S16 Local Paper

状态：S17 规范阶段；实现与验收尚未开始。S17 仅覆盖 Alpaca Paper；S18–S20、S21+ financial authority 和 S33 全量回归仍属于后续工作项。

## Problem Statement

TradeX 已能安全连接 Alpaca Paper 并读取账户、持仓和未完成订单，也能生成不可变 OrderProposal 和执行 Local Paper simulation，但用户尚不能把已审阅的 Proposal 提交给 Alpaca Paper、核对成交或撤销未完成订单。当前账户投影也没有显示 Alpaca 的 buying power 或 fills。FR-015、FR-033 和 AC-009 因此尚未完成。

如果用户只能看到 Local Paper 结果，便无法确认券商 Paper 环境实际接受或拒绝了什么；若把本地模拟状态展示成 broker 状态，或把 Paper 与 Live 路由混用，又会造成错误的账户和订单认知。

## Solution

在现有 TradeX 账户、OrderDraft/OrderProposal、Portfolio 和 Control Plane 边界上补齐 Alpaca Paper 的可验证生命周期：

- 复用用户已经确认的 `providerId=alpaca`、`environment=PAPER` 连接和 Keychain 凭据；展示真实 buying power、持仓、开放订单、订单历史和 fills。
- 将 `ALPACA_PAPER` 的不可变 Proposal 绑定到一个精确的、已连接的 Paper account 和规范 instrument。调用 Paper 专属资产能力查询，确认股票可交易以及订单字段组合受支持；缺数据或不支持时明确阻止提交并说明原因。
- 只有用户在 Trade surface 对当前 Proposal 明确确认后，Control Plane 才提交订单。界面显示 Paper 环境、账户、股票、方向、数量/金额、订单类型、限价和有效期。模型、Agent 和研究工具不能直接提交或撤单。
- 对每个请求先持久化 TradeX attempt 和稳定 client order identity，再访问 Alpaca Paper Trading API。记录 provider order identity 和规范状态。超时或连接中断可能发生在 provider 已接单之后；此时进入 `UNKNOWN_RECONCILING`，按 client order ID 先查询，绝不自动重发 POST，也不把空的一次查询当成未提交证明。
- 提供按账户查看/刷新订单和 fills、显式确认撤单、接收 Alpaca `trade_updates` 私有流，以及断线/重启后的 REST 对账。流事件是低延迟信号；provider REST 状态和活动记录用于修复遗漏。HTTP acknowledgement 表示 provider 接收了请求，不等于成交；HTTP 接受撤单也不等于订单已经取消。
- 在账户和所有订单/成交 surfaces 保留 `ALPACA_PAPER` 环境标识及 Paper 模拟限制说明。Paper 使用 Alpaca 固定 Paper endpoint 和单独凭据；Live endpoint、Live credentials、Live Gateway、arming、TradeX financial approval 和 reservation 均不进入 S17。

## User Stories

1. 作为 TradeX 用户，我希望选择已有 Alpaca Paper account，而不用重新输入 API key，以便在正确账户上继续操作。
2. 作为 Paper 用户，我希望账户页显示 Alpaca 报告的 cash、equity、buying power 和币种，以便知道订单依赖的真实 Paper 账户观测值；缺字段时显示 unavailable，不推算成 cash。
3. 作为 Paper 用户，我希望账户页和 Portfolio 能查看规范 instrument 对应的持仓、未完成订单和成交记录，并看到 provider 与 TradeX 收到时间，以便区分当前 broker 状态和历史状态。
4. 作为 Paper 用户，我希望 TradeX 用 canonical instrument 与 Alpaca 资产能力查询核对股票代码、资产类别、active/tradable 状态及 fractionable 能力，以便避免把股票代码误路由到其它资产或环境。
5. 作为 Paper 用户，我希望在 OrderDraft 中看到当前 Alpaca Paper account 的可用订单能力，并在不支持的 order type、TIF、数量语义或 asset 上看到明确原因，以便不能通过绕过 UI 的 payload 创建不支持的订单。
6. 作为 Paper 用户，我希望从与账户、环境、股票、数量/金额和 order details 绑定的不可变 Proposal 发起提交，以便发送的内容与我审阅的一致。
7. 作为 Paper 用户，我希望在发送前看到明确的 Alpaca Paper 提交确认和模拟环境披露，以便把提交意图与生成 Proposal、Local Paper simulation 和 Live financial approval 区分开。
8. 作为 Paper 用户，我希望 provider 拒绝、账户不可交易、购买力不足、资产不可交易、限流和认证失败都有准确且可恢复的提示，以便修正输入或账户状态。
9. 作为 Paper 用户，我希望网络超时后看到“状态未知/正在核对”，TradeX 先按稳定 client order ID 查询而不是再发一笔订单，以便避免重复 Paper 订单。
10. 作为 Paper 用户，我希望只在收到 Alpaca acknowledgement 后看到 broker-accepted 状态，并在收到 fill evidence 后看到成交，以便 acknowledgement 不会被误认为成交。
11. 作为 Paper 用户，我希望 TradeX 的订单列表包含从该 Alpaca account 读取到的未完成订单，即使订单最初不是由 TradeX 创建，以便完整查看 Paper account 当前状态。
12. 作为 Paper 用户，我希望撤单前刷新选中订单、查看当前 filled/remaining quantity 并显式确认，以便撤销确切的 broker order。
13. 作为 Paper 用户，我希望撤单请求接受后看到 `CANCEL_PENDING`，并在 broker 确认后才看到 `CANCELLED`；如期间发生 fill 或 provider 拒绝撤单，我希望看到该事实而不丢失成交。
14. 作为 Paper 用户，我希望实时看到 Alpaca `trade_updates` 中的新单、部分成交、完全成交、拒绝、撤单、过期及其它已支持状态，以便无需手工刷新才能观察生命周期。
15. 作为 Paper 用户，我希望私有流断开时健康状态转为 degraded，TradeX 在重连后以 REST 状态和 fill activities 对账，以便不把断流期间的状态当成最新事实。
16. 作为 Paper 用户，我希望关闭并重开 workspace 后，TradeX 仍能读取本地 attempt、broker order ID、fills 与 unresolved state，并重新查询 provider，以便恢复过程中不会重发订单。
17. 作为多账户用户，我希望每一笔订单和 stream 都绑定准确的 workspace、connection、remote account 和 PAPER environment，以便一个 Paper account 的数据不会串到另一账户或 Live。
18. 作为使用键盘或窄屏的用户，我希望确认弹窗、错误、loading、empty、stale 和 retry 状态可访问，且状态同时使用文字与标识，以便无需依赖颜色或鼠标理解和操作订单。
19. 作为 Paper 用户，我希望看到 Paper Trading 是模拟环境且成交结果不能代表 Live 表现，以便不把 simulated fills 当作真实市场执行保证。

## Implementation Decisions

- 继续使用既有 workspace、AccountConnection、OrderDraft/OrderProposal、canonical instrument、Portfolio 和 versioned Control Plane。S17 不建立 renderer-owned order model，也不把 `paper.*` Local Paper commands 改作 provider orders。
- 所有操作固定到 `alpaca` / `PAPER` connection 和 `https://paper-api.alpaca.markets`；客户端不能提交 HTTP host、provider symbol、credentials、remote account identity 或 authority flags。Alpaca Paper 以外的环境、其它 provider 和所有 Live endpoint 在本切片拒绝。
- 只接受当前 OrderDraft 已表达且 Alpaca 支持的 US equity Market/Limit order。`BASE` quantity 映射为 `qty`；`QUOTE` 映射为 `notional`，并只在 Alpaca 支持的 market/day 组合启用。限价字段、fractional eligibility 和其余 quantity/TIF 组合均由后端能力和官方约束校验；不因 S17 扩充全局 order form 来暴露未规划的 order types。
- 通过 Alpaca Paper 的资产查询获得 canonical instrument 对应的 asset metadata。只有响应 identity 与请求 symbol 一致、class 为 US equity、状态和 tradable/fractionable 能力均可验证时才允许相应订单。未知字段、未知组合或 provider 状态不可被当作成功能力。
- account observation 保留精确 decimal `buying_power` 与其币种；fills 是有稳定 provider identity、order/account/instrument identity、精确 qty/price、execution timestamp 和观测来源的持久化 provider observations。缺失 buying power、position 或 fill 字段保持 unavailable，不补零。
- 使用只允许固定 Paper endpoint、受限 HTTP method/path 和有界响应的 Rust provider transport；凭据仍只经 native secure entry / OS Keychain 读取，HTTP headers 使用 sensitive 标记。secret、Authorization header、完整 raw payload 不进入 SQLite、UI、domain events 或日志。
- 添加 typed、schema-validated provider order/asset IPC。submit 必须核对 workspace、connection、PAPER environment、连接版本、proposal identity/hash/state、proposal account/instrument/quantity、idempotency key 和已有 unresolved attempt。所有写入只由主 UI 对用户明确动作调用；Agent/研究/策略 runtime 没有提交或撤单能力。
- 写入提交 attempt 和稳定、最多 128 字符的 `client_order_id` 后才进行 provider I/O；成功响应须核对远端 account/order/client identity，持久化 normalized order 与事件。相同 TradeX attempt 重放不得生成第二个 POST。超时、无法判定的响应或 stream gap 转 `UNKNOWN_RECONCILING`，按 client order ID 查询优先恢复；一次空查询不能证明未提交。明确的 provider validation/account rejection 显示为拒绝并要求用户修正；rate limit 展示 provider retry guidance，不自动重发尚未核实的 submission。
- 支持 provider 返回的 HTTP order identity/client identity 查询、open/history order query 与 cursor pagination。响应数、页数、decimal、字符串、timestamps 和 JSON size 均有界；重复页/token、重复或冲突 ID、不完整读取返回明确的 incomplete/degraded 状态。
- Paper order lifecycle 复用 Backend ARD 的 normalized order state/event model，并保留 provider status。REST、`trade_updates` 和活动 fill 同时到达时按 provider identity 去重；过期、done-for-day、replaced、suspended、held 等状态不能被错误映射为 filled 或 cancelled。未映射状态显式显示并阻止依赖该状态的操作。
- 撤单必须定位当前 account 下的 provider order，刷新最新状态及 remaining quantity，显示不可变的 provider order/account/environment identity 后请求用户确认。HTTP 204 只记作取消已受理 / `CANCEL_PENDING`；只有 provider stream 或 REST 确认后才记录 terminal cancel。fill/cancel race、cancel rejection 和重复撤单均以 provider order truth 收敛。
- 在 `wss://paper-api.alpaca.markets/stream` 通过 Alpaca Paper credentials 认证并订阅 JSON `trade_updates`。Stream listener 按 account 生命周期启动/停止，bounded queue 与幂等 event processing 持久化 provider updates；重连、workspace reopen 和 sleep/resume 后先恢复订阅并 REST reconcile。Stream 断开不停止 account/order/fill 的 query/reconciliation。
- 从 Alpaca Trading API 的 Paper account activity `FILL` 读取历史成交并分页对账，结合 `trade_updates` 恢复 stream 缺口。新的 beta Activity SSE 不作为 S17 的必需依赖。
- `AccountConnection.health.privateStream`、`reconciliation`、`executionEligibility` 和 `lastSuccessfulSync` 反映实际的验证结果。账户身份变化、credentials unavailable、incomplete pagination、未解决提交和不可信状态各有独立提示；这些 Paper 状态不改变 Live arming (`NOT_APPLICABLE`)。
- Order / Portfolio UI 明确标注 `ALPACA_PAPER`；broker acknowledgement、pending/cancel/fill、provider observation timestamp、origin、error/retry 和 paper simulation disclosure 分开显示。用户可查看 provider 订单、成交与 TradeX attempt/history，并在明确确认后撤销支持撤单的订单。
- 不新增 Alpaca Live adapter、Live Gateway 路由、risk policy、arming、financial approval、reservation 或 manual resolution authority。后续 Live 交易和通用人工处置仍由 S21+ / S25 定义。

## Testing Decisions

- 最高行为 seam 是 Trade surface → 真实 versioned Rust IPC/provider job → 临时真实 SQLite/outbox → React projection。测试在 provider HTTP 与 private-stream transport 边界注入确定响应和事件；同一路径验证产品行为，不以纯组件 mock 或直接 parser 测试替代端到端控制面证据。
- Provider contract/fault cases 覆盖固定 Paper host、verb/path allowlist、敏感 header、资产能力、equity order request serialization、200/204/4xx/422/429、无效/超大 JSON、redirect、timeout、限流、provider auth failure、重复页、坏 cursor、身份变化、unknown status 和 secret redaction。
- SQLite/dispatcher cases 覆盖 workspace/account/proposal/env 不匹配、stale state version、duplicate idempotency、client order ID 恢复、POST timeout 后 query-first、空查询不被当作 absence、partial/full/rejected/done-for-day/expired/cancel-pending/cancelled、fill dedup、cancel/fill race、stream 重复/乱序/断线/重连、pagination incomplete、restart/reopen 和不变的 Local Paper/Live 隔离。
- Rust-backed UI integration 覆盖连接选择、能力阻止、精确 Proposal review/submit confirmation、provider acknowledgement 与 fill 分离、unknown/reconciliation/degraded、撤单确认/拒绝/race、错误和 retry、account summary 与 fills 投影、键盘/焦点/读屏语义，以及 390/768/1280 布局。
- 真实 Tauri/native credential flow 确认 Paper 连接只取现有 Keychain 引用、取消/失败不泄漏秘密，并在断流/重启后继续以同一 PAPER account 对账。单元 fixture、schema 标识或截图不能替代这项运行时证据。
- 最终 external sandbox gate 使用当前官方 Alpaca Paper credentials 执行一笔经过明确确认的可撤回 Paper-only 测试：submit → query by broker/client ID → observe state/fill/update → cancel (if still open) → verify terminal/current account state. 不调用 Live endpoint，不将 fixture 冒充真实 sandbox。创建该外部模拟订单前须获得用户对具体 Paper account/test order 的授权；若凭据或授权不可用，按 `BLOCKED_EXTERNAL` / `IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED` 记录，不标 VERIFIED。
- 完成 IPC/schema contract check、`cargo fmt --check`、workspace `cargo check`/`clippy`/tests、TS typecheck/build/unit tests、helper syntax、requirements traceability、diff check 和 Rust-backed responsive/browser tests。完整命令及精确实现 SHA 写入 resolution evidence；native package/signing 与 S33 全量回归不得由 S17 通过声明完成。

## Out of Scope

- Alpaca Live, real-money orders, live credentials, order arming/financial approval, live reservations, Privileged Live Order Gateway and generalized Manual Resolution.
- Alpaca options, crypto, multileg/bracket/OCO/OTO, short-sale enablement, margin/leverage, withdrawals/transfers/custody and broker amend/replace. 订单修改沿用 cancel + 新 Proposal 约束。
- S18 Trading 212 Demo、S19 Binance Spot Testnet、S20 Bitget Spot Demo 的 provider lifecycle，以及 S21+ cross-provider risk/authority/recovery work。
- 选择实时/历史 market-data vendor、改变 OD-001 entitlement/licensing 状态、或把 Alpaca paper-market data 作为其他数据源的替代品。
- Alpaca Paper simulation 作为 Live 成交、回测收益或未来真实交易表现的保证；S33 全应用视觉/键盘/读屏回归和 S34 签名发布包。

## Further Notes

本规范映射 PRD FR-015、FR-033 和 AC-009；UX-004 的跨环境文字状态由 S16–S20/S33 持续满足，S17 不把它提前标记为完整 VERIFIED。现有 `requirements.csv` 将 S17 条目保持 `NOT_STARTED`，实现验收后再依据跨阶段范围更新 FR-033 与 UX-004 状态。

当前依据 Alpaca 官方个人 Trading API 文档，而不是 Alpaca Broker API：

- [Authentication and separate Paper credentials](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/v1.1/docs/authentication-1)
- [Create an Order](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/reference/postorder)
- [Get All Orders and pagination](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/reference/getallorders-1)
- [Get Order by ID](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/reference/getorderbyorderid-1) and [Get Order by Client Order ID](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/reference/getorderbyclientorderid)
- [Delete Order by ID](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/reference/deleteorderbyorderid-1)
- [Get an Asset by ID or Symbol](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/reference/get-v2-assets-symbol_or_asset_id)
- [Account Activities and FILL records](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/docs/account-activities)
- [Paper trade_updates WebSocket](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/docs/websocket-streaming)
- [Order lifecycle and status definitions](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/docs/orders-at-alpaca)
- [Paper Trading assumptions and limitations](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/v1.4.2/docs/paper-trading)
